author: worker-068
gate: G-CLASSBIND (folded into G-AUDIT as calibration evidence)
motivation: FORM-HELDOUT-09, FORM-POLARITY-10 and FORM-POLARITY-11 measured that neither stage of the class-binding pipeline compares conclusion statement content against the frozen class conclusion; FORM-POLARITY-12 confirms on a fully pinned three-class shadow that non-negation content substitutions escape as well.

rule.name: conclusion statement freeze
rule.input: candidate schema F, frozen class base B (same class_id)
rule.canonicalisation: YAML parse (comments, anchors, alias and key order resolved) + Unicode NFKC + whitespace collapse + strip; no case folding
placement_options: stage A structural rule (same pass as R11, cheap)
stage B preflight check before the semantic checks
standalone preflight gate invoked with the class base as an argument
rule.why_structural: The check needs no per-class vocabulary and no mathematical judgement; it is a byte-level invariance test on the frozen contract, so it cannot itself invent or launder class content.

optional_stricter_variant.name: freeze statements + class tokens
optional_stricter_variant.predicate: R-CAND-F plus conclusion.conclusion_type / conclusion.family / conclusion.epistemic_status token equality
optional_stricter_variant.measured_overlap: flags the 3 p4 conclusion_type token flips that R11 already catches; use only if a single check is preferred over R11+R-CAND-F

measured_baseline_variant.name: negation-marker-only comparison
measured_baseline_variant.predicate: FLAG iff the count of a declared 15-token negation vocabulary differs between fixture and base for either statement
measured_baseline_variant.purpose: narrow comparison baseline; demonstrates that a polarity-only rule is insufficient

new_corpus_fully_pinned_three_class_shad.arm_calibration: identity control accepted by both stages for all three classes (3/3) - every arm informative
new_corpus_fully_pinned_three_class_shad.stage_result: 24/27 content probes escape both stages: 12/12 substitution probes (non-negation) and 12/15 polarity probes; the 3 p4 conclusion_type token flips are caught by R11; 3/3 known-rejected liveness controls still rejected
new_corpus_fully_pinned_three_class_shad.r_cand_f: flags 24/24 escaping content probes, 0/3 identity controls, 0/3 known-rejected liveness controls
new_corpus_fully_pinned_three_class_shad.r_cand_ft: flags 27/27 content probes (adds the 3 R11-caught token flips), 0/3 identity
new_corpus_fully_pinned_three_class_shad.r_cand_n: flags 12/15 polarity probes and 0/12 substitution probes

union_of_earlier_pinned_corpora.conclusion_statement_axis_escapes: 14/14 flagged by R-CAND-F (13 fresh escapes + the c0_03 reference copy)
union_of_earlier_pinned_corpora.non_statement_axis_escapes: 0/4 flagged (the FORM-HELDOUT-08 reference escapes m04/m16/m25/m29 change leaves outside conclusion.statement_*; a conclusion-statement freeze cannot catch them)
union_of_earlier_pinned_corpora.known_rejected_liveness: flagged 6/12 by R-CAND-F, harmless because they are rejected by stage A already (the rule is additive)
union_of_earlier_pinned_corpora.additional_flags_on_already_caught_probe: 6/40 - content-changing fixtures that the base stages already reject; no regression risk, but the flag set is not limited to escapes

evidence.cross_reference: worker-003's independent C0-only four-criterion lexical polarity check flagged exactly c0_03 in the 49-fixture heldout3 corpus (1/49). R-CAND-F is class-general and vocabulary-free; its union flag set is the 14 statement-axis escapes plus 6 already-caught content-changing fixtures.

declared_gap.statement: R-CAND-F covers conclusion statement content only. Escapes carried by other leaves (definitional content, i_plus.completeness_definition, class_identity_variants, anti_scope entries - the FORM-HELDOUT-08 reference families) are outside its scope and remain an open axis.
declared_gap.candidate_successor: R-CAND-D: freeze the definitions of every symbol the conclusion references (definition-site closure), which FORM-POLARITY-12 did not implement or measure.
declared_gap.falsifier: A leaf-level re-diff showing the four non-statement-axis escapes actually change a conclusion statement, or an R-CAND-D measurement showing the definition axis is already covered.

falsifier: Any conforming control flagged by R-CAND-F; any conclusion-statement escape in the union corpora that R-CAND-F does not flag; a re-run of the pinned three-class shadow in which a substitution probe is rejected by either stage; a drift in the pinned shadow or fixture bytes between build and run.
non_claims: Proposal only; adoption, gate placement and rule-id assignment belong to lead-formulation / lead-audit.
No claim about the truth of any class or of cosmic censorship.
No gate verdict, node completion, or validation_status=passed is claimed by worker-068.
